name: Ornate Tent
desc1: The inside of this large tent is decorated with simple, but elegant
desc2: knotwork tapestries of white cloth. Lit cencers fill the room with
desc3: a haze of incense smoke, which seems to sharpen the senses. A plain
desc4: cloth sleeping mat lays at the back of the tent, while a low round
desc5: table sits in the centre of the floor, encircled by sitting cushions.
